title: FilesReadParams
description: Read a UTF-8 text file inside the grant's canonical paths. The window is bounded to the first 64 KiB of complete source lines; output lines are numbered from one, and the opaque revision binds a later files.edit to the exact bytes and identity observed here. Binary or invalid UTF-8 files are reported without text. Original trailing whitespace, BOM and line endings are not normalized for revision purposes; edits preserve the source line-ending style.

path.description: Path of the file to read, inside the grant's paths.

result.title: FilesReadResult
result.description: What files.read hands back. Binary content is reported, never pasted: binary is true and text is absent. The revision is a strict compare-and-swap token for files.edit.

total.description: The file's complete size in bytes.

revision.description: Opaque revision tied to the exact bytes and canonical identity observed by this read.

start.description: First byte of the source window returned, counting from 0.

end.description: One past the last byte of the source window returned.

start.description: First displayed source line number, inclusive.

end.description: Last displayed source line number, inclusive; zero when no complete line fit.

seen.description: The only source lines a later files.edit may address under this revision.

returned.description: Source bytes represented by the returned complete-line window; less than total means the window is partial.

truncated.description: True when the result retained only part of the source window.

dropped.description: Source bytes omitted from this result because of the declared bound.

remaining.description: Source bytes still omitted after this result.

binary.description: True when the content is binary or invalid UTF-8. Absent means false.

text.description: Numbered text of the returned complete lines. Absent for binary content and for an empty window.
